story:
Since 1984, GreenTree Inc. has provided high-quality landscape maintenance services to some of the most well-known properties throughout South Florida. We are a local, Minority Certified, family owned and run business dedicated solely to landscape maintenance. Our unwavering commitment to excellence is evident in every property we take on, and it has helped us build a reputation as one of South Florida's premier commercial landscape maintenance companies.

With a specific focus on commercial clients, we bring landscapes to life — nurturing their environment and enhancing the natural beauty of their surroundings. Our diligent approach, our emphasis on safety and our meticulous care for your property are what set us apart.

What that focus really means is that maintenance is not something we do between installations. It is the whole business, and it has been for forty-two years. That is why our schedules hold, why our crews know the properties they service, and why the standard a client is shown in the first month is the standard they are still getting a decade later. In a trade where contracts turn over constantly and long-established local firms are steadily being absorbed into regional brands, GreenTree remains independent, family run, and answerable directly to the people whose properties we look after.
